# @fyit/crouton-flow

> Interactive node graph visualization for collections with real-time multiplayer sync

AI hint: use when app needs graph/DAG visualization, decision trees, or flow diagrams

## Components

- `CroutonFlow`: Interactive node graph with DAG auto-layout, drag/drop, minimap, and optional real-time sync
- `CroutonFlowSiteFlow`: Site level of the Crouton Builder: a canvas of page cards wired into a sitemap

Props, events and slots: [components.md](components.md)

## Composables

- `useFlowData`
- `useFlowLayout`
- `useFlowMutation`
- `useFlowPresence`
- `useFlowSync`
